title: A single transient failed index read after a run's record settled can resume its wait without the run's diagnostics
outcome: A run wait on a bound run whose record settled resumes with the run's failure diagnostics whenever a later index read could still supply them, rather than giving the record-derived verdict on the first transient failed read.
acceptance: When the index's last good read of a bound run was still running and its next read fails once after the run's record settled, the wait takes the record-derived verdict only once that failure persists past the index's grace (for example read_failures >= 2), so a following successful read supplies the diagnostics; covered by a behaviour test.
